new_checks.predicate: For each HTTP listener and every effective basic rule or path-map default/path rule, FAIL when a fully resolved route forwards without redirect or redirects to an HTTP listener or non-HTTPS target URL. PASS when all effective routes redirect to an HTTPS listener or HTTPS URL using a schema-valid redirectType (Permanent, Found, SeeOther or Temporary). new_checks.title: Redirect all Application Gateway HTTP listeners to HTTPS

requirements.name: Azure Aplication Gateway
requirements.reason: The requirement asks for Azure Application Gateway uses SSL certificates provided by Azure Key Vault. No reviewed native Azure evaluator tests this exact resource setting; the proposed read-only predicate covers it.

new_checks.data_source: Application Gateway GET 2026-01-01 properties.httpListeners[].properties.sslCertificate.id and properties.sslCertificates[].properties.keyVaultSecretId; resolve referenced Key Vault secret/certificate version with data-plane GET and validate expiry and trust where the source requires a trusted certificate.
new_checks.predicate: For every HTTPS Application Gateway listener, resolve properties.sslCertificate.id to the gateway sslCertificates entry. FAIL when a complete gateway response shows no certificate binding or no nonempty properties.keyVaultSecretId. PASS only when every applicable listener references a Key Vault secret and its current certificate is valid and trusted as required by the frozen rule; UNKNOWN when Key Vault status, trust chain, expiry, access or inventory cannot be checked.
new_checks.title: Application Gateway HTTPS listeners use Key Vault-backed server certificates
new_checks.description: Checks TLS server certificate bindings on HTTPS listeners; this does not measure client-certificate authentication.
new_checks.remediation_hint: Bind a valid, trusted Key Vault-backed TLS certificate to each HTTPS listener and ensure the gateway identity can read it.

requirements.name: Azure AD

new_checks.data_source: ARM Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions ListForScope 2022-04-01; exact fields: Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions[].properties.permissions[].actions,notActions,dataActions,notDataActions; parameter blockedKeyVaultActions.
new_checks.predicate: For each in-scope managed custom RBAC role/policy assigned or assignable to Azure Key Vault keys, expand actions/dataActions and subtract notActions/notDataActions using provider operation semantics. FAIL if an effective operation matches blockedKeyVaultActions. PASS only when complete definitions, applicable scopes/assignments and policy prove no blocked effective operation. UNKNOWN if the prohibited action set, operation catalogue, wildcard expansion, conditions or assignment/scope inventory is unresolved.
new_checks.title: Custom RBAC roles exclude prohibited Key Vault actions

requirements.name: Azure Key Vault

new_checks.predicate: For each currently enabled certificate from complete paged /certificates enumeration, GET its current version. PASS when attributes.exp is an integer Unix timestamp later than scanTime plus the approved expirationWithinDays. FAIL when a complete current certificate has no expiry or is within that window. UNKNOWN if the threshold, pages, current-version resolution or authorization is missing. No enabled certificates is NOT_APPLICABLE.
new_checks.title: Enabled Key Vault certificates are outside the expiry window
